verdict.rationale: Blaxel is a cloud platform for sandboxes, agent hosting, and MCP servers, so asking whether its source is openly licensed is a fair question. The evidence pack never shows the platform's own source published under an open license. The only open-source mention is an auxiliary migration skill, which is an adjacent artifact and not the product's source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
